root_cause_of_hold: design assumption, not tool or broker defect: OpenAPI nextBefore null means end of retained history; from an empty initial cursor terminal null requires walking AAPL 1m history to its beginning, unreachable within 4x200. Encoded at tasks.md 0.7b/0.7b.2/0.7c, design.md M-B1 paragraph, spec M-B1 scenarios, main.go:134/170-171.
operational_precondition_discovered: StockOS infra-toss-intelligence-1 shares the same OpenAPI credential with an in-memory-only token; the broker keeps one live token per credential, so its re-issue killed the shared cache token roughly once a minute (13:10 first-run HTTP 401 and soak cycle 14 walk 401). It was stopped by the human at ~15:56 KST before this run; the cache token stayed stable for >4.5 minutes afterwards. Any future M-B run needs every foreign credential holder enumerated and quiescent.
